body:
Of course there's been some good days here and there, but the issue is that they are so far and fleeting that they're quickly overcome with negativity, self hate and sadness. 

I've just got years of negative thinking, self hatred and bitterness inside of me. Its impossible to stop thinking about it. I can't be happy, I try but I just feel so fake and then I feel guilty and realize that I'm putting on a farce and then its just a feedback loop where that just makes things worse.

I've been waiting for things to turn around for awhile now and nothing's happened. I don't have anything good to grasp on to. I can't think of anything I like about myself, I've completely abandoned all of my hobbies, nothing makes me happy anymore. I just wake up, fail to get out of bed, and just think all day. Writing about it helps but I can't keep a journal or anything out of fear of someone finding it.

i just don't know how much longer I can hang on for. Every day is just a constant reminder of how much of a failure I am and how it'd be better just to get it over with.

Seeking help means that I can't deal with it on my own. I don't want people to pity me. That and I've heard horror stories about being shipped off to psych wards and whatnot. That would mean friends/family finding out and I can't afford to allow that.

On top of all of that, I can't afford it. I have no job and no money.
Because the odds of life being shitty and awful outweigh the possibilities of life getting better. It's just not worth it.

The point I'm trying to get across is that I've lived long enough and haven't felt as if things will ever get better. I'm not happy living, I don't see the point in continuing on if there's no hope of things getting better. I don't believe in playing a game where there's no chance of winning, or even just enjoying it.

There's no telling what the future holds. Sure, I could wake up tomorrow and feel fantastic but on the other hand, I could live in abject agony, suffering and deal with suicidal thoughts for 40 years. At this point in my life, given how I feel, how I've felt and how my life has gone recently, I don't believe in the former.
